description.value: Coffee Love Bug is a small cafe on Cumberland Road in the Courtenay area of Vancouver Island, tucked into a dedicated building and serving a condensed weekly schedule. Its location along a Vancouver Island cycling corridor makes it a potential rest stop for riders exploring the region. No further details about the menu or interior were retrievable from the website.
